questions.question: In a letter to a chosen lady, what made the elder overjoyed about some of her children?

answers.text: They were walking in the truth
They were teaching in the synagogues
They were caring for the widows

questions.question: In his letter to a chosen lady, which commandment did the elder urge her to follow?

answers.text: That we rest on the Sabbath

questions.question: The elder warned a chosen lady about many deceivers in the world. What did these deceivers refuse to confess?

answers.text: The coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh
The creation of the heavens and earth
The words of the prophets of old

questions.question: The elder wrote to a chosen lady that greeting someone who does not bring the teaching of Christ means sharing in his evil deeds. True or false?
